blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V160 renders: the narrower hem makes the front-facing neutral and three-quarter pleat ribs easier to distinguish, but the rear and oblique skirt still read as a few broad wedge panels rather than a consistent fine pleat cadence. Product appearance remains rejected.
Crouch and sit still expose the angular thigh-cover shell and separated under-skirt faces around the bent legs; the panel does not follow the pose closely enough to establish coverage or fit.
Front and three-quarter views retain pinched and faceted lower-torso patches and an uneven jacket-to-skirt transition around the waist.
The prone render still shows the skirt as a rigid radial fan across the body and limbs instead of plausible cloth drape. Hem-width reduction did not change this pose response.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
